name: Cadence Elise
original_name: エリーゼ ケイデンス
source:
Likes: Occult
Dislikes: People

Elise is a wealthy girl with an interest in the occult. She is a shut-in.
Elise wishes to find God, and more so, find “him.” She is very similar to RaiDaaku, thus making her the ideal heroine.
